# Engine API

## Page anatomy (generated by `beat_template.build`)
```
<body data-offset data-dur data-beat data-part data-grain>
  #wrap > #stage (1080x1920)
      .layer (bg colour) · your BODY layers · #cutBlack (closing plate)
      + injected: #grain (film grain) · #vig (vignette) · #filmic · #guides (safe zones)
  #ui (play / replay / scrub bar / audio loader / notes)
  shared.js (+ motion.js if gsap) · your SCRIPT
```
- `.layer` = absolute full-frame. For a placed box use `class="layer place"` **and** explicit
  left/top/width/height (plain `.layer` keeps right/bottom at 0 and ignores width/height).
- `class="layer center"` centres its child. Keep shot-specific art inside SVG layers with
  `viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"`.
- Shot dict keys for `build()`: `n, title, off, dur, tc, file, body, script, notes, legend, grain,
  bg, gsap` (set `gsap=True` to load GSAP + motion.js for camera-rig shots).

## Timeline (python, scripts/timing.py)
`T = Timeline("timings.json", hold)` → `T.DUR`, `T.OFF`, `T.TOTAL`, `T.W(n,w,occ)`, `T.WE(n,w,occ)`,
`T.WS(n,a,b,oa,ob)`, `T.tc(n)`. Shots are cut in the middle of the pause between paragraphs.
Words match case/punctuation-insensitively ("I'm"→"im", "twenty-five"→"twentyfive"); "I can't" is
two words. Use `occ` for repeated words — the KeyError lists the shot's words when you get it wrong.

## EL (CSS-animation helpers, shared.js)
| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| `EL.anim(el, name, delay, dur, ease)` | one keyframe animation (paused until play/seek) |
| `EL.animMulti(el, [{name,dur,delay,ease,fill,iter}])` | several animations on one element — **use this instead of calling EL.anim twice** |
| `EL.loop(el, name, dur, ease, alternate)` | infinite ambient loop |
| `EL.kineticWords(el, {name:"wordIn", stagger, dur, delay})` | per-word reveal; preserves `<br>` and coloured `<span>`s; use for anything that wraps |
| `EL.kinetic(el, {name:"riseMask", stagger, dur, delay})` | per-character reveal for short display lines |
| `EL.syncWords(el, times)` | re-time each word to the voice (times from `T.WS`) |
| `EL.pages(mount, [{text, at, end, cls, times}], {attr, top, hold, holdGaps})` | quote card that turns pages; never overlaps; returns cards |
| `EL.qcard(mount, {text, attr, cls, pop, dur})` | a single quote card (`cls:"big"`/`"sm"`) |
| `EL.ncard(mount, {kicker, text, at, top, size, times, end})` | narrator headline with kicker |
| `EL.clock(cx, cy, r)` | wall clock SVG; animate `.hand` with `clockTick` + `steps(60)` |
| `EL.ticks(svg, {from, step})` | draw `.tick` paths like pen strokes |
| `EL.crowd(svg, {pop, step, redAt})` | 100 pictograms: light most, then single out six |
| `EL.rng(seed)`, `EL.noise`, `EL.ridge`, `EL.plane` | seeded procedural helpers |
| `#counter` with `data-count-to/start/end` | count-up driven by the shared clock |

### Motion helpers (all scrub-exact: they are driven by the one clock, so seeking backwards works)
| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| `EL.every(t => …)` | run a function on every rendered frame — procedural motion (orbits, physics, noise drift, live numbers). Must be a pure function of `t`. |
| `EL.drawOn(root, at, dur, stagger, ease, sel)` | draw every stroke inside `root` on, in document order (measures path lengths for you) |
| `EL.morph(path, [d1, d2, …], at, dur, ease, {loop})` | morph a `<path>` through shapes. Shapes must have the **same command structure** (e.g. `ART.blob` with the same point count) |
| `EL.counter(el, from, to, at, dur, {decimals, prefix, suffix, comma})` | count-up that lands on the spoken number |
| `EL.scramble(el, at, dur)` | decode/"hacker" text resolve — kickers, labels, codes |
| `EL.typewriter(el, at, cps, {caret})` | typed text at `cps` characters per second |
| `EL.alongPath(el, path, at, dur, {rotate, offset})` | move an element along an SVG path (a plane on a route, a dot on a graph) |
| `EL.annotate(el, kind, at, {color, pad, dur, from})` | hand-drawn mark on any element on stage: `circle`, `underline`, `highlight`, `box`, `arrowTo` (needs `from:[x,y]`). Measured lazily from the real layout, wraps per line |
| `EL.boxOf(el)` / `EL.rectsOf(el)` | an element's stage-space box / per-line boxes (for placing your own marks) |

## KIT (kit.js) — the creative toolkit
Everything returns SVG markup strings in 1080×1920 user space. Insert into an `<svg>`, then animate
with the helpers above. `KIT.defs()` is injected automatically.

- **Backgrounds `KIT.bg.*`** — `aurora(colors, seed)` (+ `animateAurora(root, dur)`), `lowPoly(colors, seed)`,
  `topo(seed)`, `bokeh(colors, n)`, `waves(colors, y0)`, `starfield(n)`, `sunburst(cx, cy, n, a, b)`,
  `halftoneFade(color)`, `dotGrid(color)`, `isoGrid(color)`. All accept a box `x, y, w, h` so they also
  fill panels and cards.
- **Art directions `KIT.style.*`** — `clay(x,y,w,h,color)` soft 3D, `glass(x,y,w,h)` frosted panel,
  `bauhaus(seed)`, `pixel(rows, palette, x, y, size)` (rows of palette indices), `bubble(x,y,w,h,tailX,tailY)`
  speech balloon, `burst(cx,cy,r)` comic "POW", `actionLines(cx,cy)`, `wash(d,color)` watercolour,
  `riso(d,inkA,inkB)` misregistered print, `chalk(d)` chalkboard line, `network(n, seed)` constellation.
- **Characters `KIT.person(x, y, scale, pose, color, outline)`** — poses `stand walk wave point cheer
  think sit`. Wrapped in `<g class="person">` so you can animate it without breaking its transform.
- **Icons `KIT.icon(name, x, y, size, color, width)`** — 36 line icons (`KIT.ICONS`): person group heart
  brain clock calendar globe coin bars trendUp trendDown warning check cross bolt eye lock house moon
  sun phone chat bulb book leaf drop flag search play music shield pin atom star gift rocket.
  Stroke-only, so `EL.drawOn` draws them.
- **Data `KIT.chart.*`** — `bars(values, {labels, colors, max})` (animate `.bar` with `barFill`),
  `hbars(items)`, `line(values, {area, dots})` (draw `.ln` on), `donut(cx,cy,r,pct)` + `fillRing(el, at)`,
  `waffle(filled)`, `timeline(events)`.
- **Hand-drawn notes `KIT.annot.*`** — `circle underline arrow highlight cross check bracket` at
  explicit coordinates (or use `EL.annotate` to target an element).
- **Colour** — `KIT.PALETTES` and `KIT.mix(a, b, t)`, `KIT.shade(color, ±k)`.

## Palettes (palettes.css)
Pass `palette="neonNight"` (etc.) to a shot to re-skin every token: `documentary` (default dark),
`warmStory`, `pastel`, `neonNight`, `paperEarth`, `blueprint`, `printRetro`. Pick one per film;
switch only for a deliberate register change.

## Cookbook
`gallery.py` builds four pages (`gallery-1..4.html`) showing every background, style, character,
icon, chart and annotation; read `gallery.py` for the exact calls. Open them before designing — the
fastest way to see what the kit can do.

## M (GSAP engine, motion.js — only on `gsap=True` shots)
`const rig = M.cam(el, {perspective, origin})` · `M.plane(el, depth, {scale})` ·
`const T = M.use(M.tl())` (name it **T** — the validator looks for `T.`/`M.` calls) ·
`M.rise(el, at, {dur, x, y, scale, ease})` · `M.typeIn(el, at, {stagger, dur, y})` ·
`M.parallax(rig, [planes...], {amount, dur, rotate})` · `M.count(el, at, {to, dur})` ·
`M.EASE.{reveal, settle, glide, camera, colour, snap, breathe}`.
GSAP shots: a CSS animation on the same element overrides GSAP — remove it
(`el.style.removeProperty("animation-name")`) before handing the element to GSAP.

## ART (defs.js)
Scenes: `room()` (or planes `roomWall/roomWindow/roomFurniture`), `figure(x,y,s,seed,op,pose)`,
`figureStanding(x,y,s,op,rimColour)`, `SEAT`, `bench()`, `benchDay()`, `sofaScene()`, `corridor()`,
`groupRoom()`, `hospitalRoom()`, `oneDay()`. Data: `grid(step,colour)`, `regMarks()`, `crowd()`,
`dotField()`, `flatline(y)` (returns a path d), `fiveTicks(x,y)`.
Style kit: `blob(cx,cy,r,seed,points,wobble)` → path d · `wave(y,amp,len,phase,x0,x1)` → path d ·
`isoBox(x,y,w,depth,h,top,left,right,stroke)` · `sphere(cx,cy,r,id,light,mid,dark)` ·
`particles(n,seed,x0,y0,w,h,colour)` (class `pt`) · `paperLayers(colours,seed,top,bottom,w,gap,amp)` ·
`blueprintSheet(x,y,w,h,title)` · `ink(d,colour,width)` · `neon(d,colour,width)`.
Style filters/patterns: `rough`, `paperTex`, `paperShadow`, `neon`, `hatch`, `halftone`, `blueprintGrid`.
Classes used only as JS hooks must be declared in shared.css (see the hooks line at the end).
Paint & filters: `injectDefs(["warmRoom","keyLight","coldField","shaft","haze"])` at the top of every
shot script (support filters `soft2/6/18/40`, `glowF`, `glowBig`, `grainF` are always included).

## Keyframe catalogue (shared.css)
- **Basic:** `f0` fade in · `f1` fade out (names read backwards — careful) · `fadeIn` · `fadeUp` ·
  `cardOut` (out) · `dimOut` (to .34) · `quietIn` (soft rise in) · `nIn` (hard in) · `qIn` (soft slide in).
- **Text:** `wordIn` (synced words) · `riseMask` / `riseSettle` (display characters) · `slam` · `smearIn`.
- **Pop/mass:** `popIn` · `popInHard` · `dotPop` · `plateRise` · `capEnter` (slide from right).
- **Draw:** `lineDraw` / `molDraw` / `drawStroke` (stroke-dashoffset, set `--dash`) · `tickDraw` ·
  `tickHalf` (stops half drawn) · `ruleDraw` / `growW` / `strikeDraw` (scaleX) · `growH` / `barFill` (scaleY) ·
  `hlSweep` (highlight under text).
- **Camera/ambient:** `pushIn` · `pushIn2` · `pullBack` · `driftA/B/Slow/X` · `breath` · `shimmerK` ·
  `gridBreathe` · `scanDown` · `snowFall` · `ghostDrift` · `lampBreath` · `ripple`.
- **Light/colour:** `warmPeak` · `cool` · `coolLess` · `bloom` · `greenGlow` · `lightOn` (tube flicker) ·
  `dayNight` (window time-lapse) · `ringGlow`.
- **Counters:** `reelTo13` / `reelRun` (digit reel, use `.reel`) · `monthReel` · `clockTick`.
- **Story motion:** `sink` (recline torso) · `approach` · `recede` · `shakeS` · `distress` (tiny arcs) ·
  `coverLift` (x-ray reveal) · `figLit` / `figUnlit`.
- **Transitions & entrances (kit):** `irisIn`/`irisOut` (circle reveal) · `wipeDiag` · `wipeUp` · `wipeLeft` ·
  `splitOpen` · `zoomThrough` (camera flies through into the next shot) · `zoomIn` · `rackIn`/`rackOut`
  (focus pull) · `glitchShift` · `bounceIn` · `flipIn` · `squashLand` · `dropIn` · `spinIn` · `ringFill`.
- **Ambient (kit):** `auroraDrift` · `twinkle` · `floatY` · `spin` · `pulseScale` · `leak` (light leak) ·
  `shimmerSweep` (sheen across `.sheen`).
Add new keyframes to shared.css; give fade-outs an explicit `from{opacity:1}`.
